facts.fact: The 2025 finance law (loi n°042-2024/ALT of 23 December 2024) appropriates 5,845,994,000 F CFA in domestic payment credits to programme 136 'Transformation et écosystème numérique' of the digital ministry (MTD-PCE), of which 4,086,853,000 is a single Microsoft licensing chapter; counterpart funding is excluded, so the figure is a floor.
facts.system: MTD-PCE budget 2025, programme 136 Transformation et écosystème numérique

note: No rise/fell: the document gives 2025 only, and no actual spending.
